text: Fixing #5729/#5730 (preprocessor): real VFP9 (COMPILE + SET LOGERRORS ON, retained ~/temp/vfp9-probes/preprocessor-5729-5730) logs compile errors for a missing #INCLUDE and a stray #ENDIF/#ELSE, but is SILENT for an unterminated #IFDEF, duplicate #ELSE and cross-file #ENDIF (it just drops the rest of the program). Implementing the issues' owner-approved behavior: active missing/unreadable #INCLUDE and every unbalanced-conditional form stop with a file+line diagnostic (host: status error, non-zero exit); inactive-branch includes still ignored; the stricter-than-VFP cases are documented as intentional. Migration note: a program that #INCLUDEs a header Copperfin does not ship (e.g. FOXPRO.H) now stops with an error. Fail-first: 32 failures before, 0 after.
